helpers.bcdToNumber:
function bcdToNumber(tbl)
  value = ''
  for i, name in ipairs(tbl) do
    value = value .. string.format('%02x', name)
  end
  return tonumber(value);
end
helpers.firstIndexOf:
function firstIndexOf(str, substr)
  local i = string.find(str, substr, 1, true)
  if i == nil then
    return 0
  end
  return i
end
helpers.first_index:
function first_index(t, elem)
  for k, v in ipairs(t) do
    if v == elem then
      return k
    end
  end
  return 0
end
helpers.frequencyAsNumber:
function frequencyAsNumber(tbl)
  value = ''
  for i, name in ipairs(tbl) do
    value = string.format('%02x', name) .. value
  end
  return tonumber(value);
end
helpers.frequencyToBcd:
function frequencyToBcd(freq, tblsize)
  freq = math.floor(freq + 0.5)
  local bcdTable = {}
  while freq > 0 do
    local nibble = freq % 10
    table.insert(bcdTable, 1, nibble)
    freq = math.floor(freq / 10)
  end
  if #bcdTable % 2 == 1 then
    table.insert(bcdTable, 1, 0)
  end
  local finalTable = {}
  for i = 1, #bcdTable, 2 do
    local nibble1 = bcdTable[i+1]
    local nibble2 = bcdTable[i]
    local bcdValue = nibble2 * 16 + nibble1
    table.insert(finalTable, 1, bcdValue)
  end
  if tblsize ~= nil then
    while #finalTable < tblsize do
      table.insert(finalTable, 0x00)
    end
  end
  return finalTable
end
helpers.icomClock:
function icomClock(dateCmd, timeCmd, part)
  local d = icomQuery(dateCmd)
  local t = icomQuery(timeCmd)
  local function bcd(b) return math.floor(b / 16) * 10 + b % 16 end
  local c = {year = 0, month = 0, day = 0, hour = 0, minute = 0}
  if #d >= 4 then
    c.year = bcd(d[1]) * 100 + bcd(d[2])
    c.month = bcd(d[3])
    c.day = bcd(d[4])
  end
  if #t >= 2 then
    c.hour = bcd(t[1])
    c.minute = bcd(t[2])
  end
  if part == "time" then return string.format("%02d:%02d", c.hour, c.minute) end
  if part == "date" then return string.format("%04d-%02d-%02d", c.year, c.month, c.day) end
  return c[part]
end
helpers.icomGps:
function icomGps()
  local d = icomQuery({0x23}, {0x00})   -- d[1] is the sub command 00
  if #d < 28 then return nil end
  local function bcd(i, n)
    local v = 0
    for k = i, i + n - 1 do v = v * 100 + math.floor(d[k] / 16) * 10 + d[k] % 16 end
    return v
  end
  local g = {}
  g.lat = bcd(2, 1) + (bcd(3, 1) + bcd(4, 1) / 100 + math.floor(d[5] / 16) / 1000) / 60
  if d[6] % 16 == 0 then g.lat = -g.lat end   -- 0 = south
  g.lon = (d[7] % 16) * 100 + bcd(8, 1) + (bcd(9, 1) + bcd(10, 1) / 100 + math.floor(d[11] / 16) / 1000) / 60
  if d[12] % 16 == 0 then g.lon = -g.lon end  -- 0 = west
  g.alt = 0
  if d[13] ~= 0xFF then                       -- FF = no altitude
    g.alt = bcd(13, 3) / 10
    if d[16] % 16 == 1 then g.alt = -g.alt end
  end
  g.course = bcd(17, 2)
  g.speed = bcd(19, 3) / 10
  g.year = bcd(22, 2)
  g.month = bcd(24, 1)
  g.day = bcd(25, 1)
  g.hour = bcd(26, 1)
  g.minute = bcd(27, 1)
  g.second = bcd(28, 1)
  return g
end
helpers.icomGpsTime:
function icomGpsTime(part)
  local g = icomGps()
  if g == nil then
    if part == "text" then return "" end
    return 0
  end
  if part == "unix" then return icomUnixTime(g.year, g.month, g.day, g.hour, g.minute, g.second) end
  if part == "text" then
    return string.format("%04d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d:%02d", g.year, g.month, g.day, g.hour, g.minute, g.second)
  end
  return g[part]
end
helpers.icomGpsValue:
function icomGpsValue(name)
  local g = icomGps()
  if g == nil then return 0 end
  return g[name]
end
helpers.icomLocator:
function icomLocator(lat, lon)
  lon = lon + 180
  lat = lat + 90
  local A, a = string.byte("A"), string.byte("a")
  return string.char(A + math.floor(lon / 20), A + math.floor(lat / 10))
      .. math.floor((lon % 20) / 2) .. math.floor(lat % 10)
      .. string.char(a + math.floor((lon % 2) * 12), a + math.floor((lat % 1) * 24))
end
helpers.icomName:
function icomName(d, names, default)
  if d[1] == nil then return default end
  local name = d[2] and names[d[1] * 256 + d[2]]
  return name or names[d[1]] or default
end
helpers.icomReadDtcs:
function icomReadDtcs()
  local d = icomQuery({0x1B, 0x02})
  if #d < 3 then return 0 end
  return (d[2] % 16) * 100 + math.floor(d[3] / 16) * 10 + d[3] % 16
end
helpers.icomReadNumber:
function icomReadNumber(cmd, data)
  local d = icomQuery(cmd, data)
  if #d == 0 then return 0 end
  return bcdToNumber(d) or 0
end
helpers.icomRitData:
function icomRitData(hz)
  hz = math.floor(hz + 0.5)
  local sign = 0
  if hz < 0 then sign = 1; hz = -hz end
  local t = frequencyToBcd(math.min(hz, 9999), 2)
  table.insert(t, sign)
  return t
end
helpers.icomScale:
function icomScale(raw, points)
  for i = 2, #points do
    if raw <= points[i][1] or i == #points then
      local x0, y0, x1, y1 = points[i-1][1], points[i-1][2], points[i][1], points[i][2]
      return y0 + (raw - x0) * (y1 - y0) / (x1 - x0)
    end
  end
  return points[1][2]
end
helpers.icomTextBytes:
function icomTextBytes(text)
  local t = {}
  text = tostring(text)
  for i = 1, math.min(#text, 30) do
    t[i] = string.byte(text, i)
  end
  return t
end
helpers.icomUnixTime:
function icomUnixTime(y, m, d, hour, minute, second)
  if m <= 2 then y = y - 1; m = m + 12 end
  local days = 365 * y + math.floor(y / 4) - math.floor(y / 100) + math.floor(y / 400)
  days = days + math.floor((153 * (m - 3) + 2) / 5) + d - 719469
  return days * 86400 + hour * 3600 + minute * 60 + second
end
helpers.kvGet:
function kvGet(key, default)
  local value = kvLoad()[tostring(key)]
  if value == nil then return default end
  return value
end
helpers.kvLoad:
function kvLoad()
  if _kvStore == nil then
    _kvStore = {}
    local text = storageRead('memory.lua')
    local chunk = text and load(text)
    if chunk then
      local ok, store = pcall(chunk)
      if ok and type(store) == 'table' then _kvStore = store end
    end
  end
  return _kvStore
end
helpers.kvSet:
function kvSet(key, value)
  local store = kvLoad()
  key = tostring(key)
  if store[key] == value then return end
  store[key] = value
  kvSave()
end
helpers.list_string_split:
function list_string_split(input, delim)
  local t = {}
  local pos = 1
  while true do
    next_delim = string.find(input, delim, pos)
    if next_delim == nil then
      table.insert(t, string.sub(input, pos))
      break
    else
      table.insert(t, string.sub(input, pos, next_delim-1))
      pos = next_delim + #delim
    end
  end
  return t
end
helpers.list_sublist_from_start_from_start:
function list_sublist_from_start_from_start(source, at1, at2)
  local t = {}
  local start = at1
  local finish = at2
  for i = start, finish do
    table.insert(t, source[i])
  end
  return t
end
helpers.math_sum:
function math_sum(t)
  local result = 0
  for _, v in ipairs(t) do
    result = result + v
  end
  return result
end
helpers.numberToBcd:
function numberToBcd(number, tblsize)
  number = math.floor(number)
  local bcdTable = {}
  while number > 0 do
    local nibble = number % 10
    table.insert(bcdTable, 1, nibble)
    number = math.floor(number / 10)
  end
  if #bcdTable % 2 == 1 then
    table.insert(bcdTable, 1, 0)
  end
  local finalTable = {}
  for i = 1, #bcdTable, 2 do
    local nibble1 = bcdTable[i]
    local nibble2 = bcdTable[i+1]
    local bcdValue = nibble2 + nibble1 * 16
    table.insert(finalTable, bcdValue)
  end
  if(tblsize ~= nil) then
    while #finalTable < tblsize do
      table.insert(finalTable, 1, 0x00)
    end
  end
  return finalTable
end
helpers.pretty:
function pretty(tbl)
  hex = {}
  for i, name in ipairs(tbl) do
    hex[i] = string.format('0x%02x ', name)
  end
  return '{' .. table.concat(hex, ',') .. '}'
end
helpers.ringAverage:
function ringAverage(list)
  if ringCount(list) == 0 then return 0 end
  return ringSum(list) / #list
end
helpers.ringSum:
function ringSum(list)
  local sum = 0
  for _, v in ipairs(list or {}) do sum = sum + v end
  return sum
end
helpers.storageCheck:
function storageCheck(ok, err)
  if not ok then print('Storage: ' .. tostring(err)) end
  return ok == true
end
helpers.storageExists:
function storageExists(name)
  local file = io.open(name, 'r')
  if file then file:close() end
  return file ~= nil
end
helpers.storageLines:
function storageLines(name)
  local lines = {}
  local file = io.open(name, 'r')
  if not file then return lines end
  for line in file:lines() do
    line = string.gsub(line, '\r$', '')
    if line ~= '' then lines[#lines + 1] = line end
  end
  file:close()
  return lines
end
helpers.storageLiteral:
function storageLiteral(v)
  local t = type(v)
  if t == 'string' then return string.format('%q', v) end
  if t == 'number' or t == 'boolean' then return tostring(v) end
  if t == 'table' then
    local parts = {}
    for k, x in pairs(v) do parts[#parts + 1] = '[' .. storageLiteral(k) .. '] = ' .. storageLiteral(x) end
    return '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  return 'nil'
end
helpers.storageRead:
function storageRead(name)
  local file, err = io.open(name, 'r')
  if not file then return nil, err end
  local text = file:read('a')
  file:close()
  return text
end
helpers.storageWrite:
function storageWrite(name, text, mode)
  local file, err = io.open(name, mode or 'w')
  if not file then return nil, err end
  local ok, werr = file:write(tostring(text))
  file:close()
  if not ok then return nil, werr end
  return true
end
helpers.text_count:
function text_count(haystack, needle)
  if #needle == 0 then
    return #haystack + 1
  end
  local i = 1
  local count = 0
  while true do
    i = string.find(haystack, needle, i, true)
    if i == nil then
      break
    end
    count = count + 1
    i = i + #needle
  end
  return count
end
helpers.text_replace:
function text_replace(haystack, needle, replacement)
  local buf = {}
  local i = 1
  while i <= #haystack do
    if string.sub(haystack, i, i + #needle - 1) == needle then
      for j = 1, #replacement do
        table.insert(buf, string.sub(replacement, j, j))
      end
      i = i + #needle
    else
      table.insert(buf, string.sub(haystack, i, i))
      i = i + 1
    end
  end
  return table.concat(buf)
end
